name: calculate
description: Work out arithmetic exactly and convert units: sums, percentages, multiplication, division, powers, square and cube roots, and conversions between SI and common units (length, weight, volume, area, speed, time, temperature, data size, energy, pressure) including lakh and crore. Use it for any calculation or conversion instead of working it out in your head.

expression.description: plain arithmetic such as 17 * 300 / 100, 17 percent of 300 or sqrt(144) + 2 ^ 5; or a conversion written as a number, a unit and a target such as 5 km in miles, 98.6 F to C or 2.5 crore to million (leave the target out to get a few alternatives)

examples: what is the square root of 144
what is 2 to the power of 10
